hero_intro: Bespoke furniture, facade elements and custom objects, brought together through material expertise, workshop fabrication and on-site installation where required.
methods_intro: Explore the options by cost, detail, durability and setting. The same object can be made using different materials and processes.
cost_note: Cost levels are general guidance. We quote according to dimensions, quantity, finish and installation scope.
works_intro: Selected examples from our own archive. For a similar project, share the intended use, dimensions and finish.
archive_intro: This gallery brings together workshop and installation photographs from different jobs. Materials and scope are specified separately for your project.
brief_checklist: Share approximate dimensions, a reference drawing or photo, quantity, setting and installation needs. We can then define materials and connections.
selection_empty: You have not selected a project yet.
selection_limit: You can select up to 6 examples.
selection_intro: Include your selected examples in one project enquiry. These selections are references, not an order or price commitment.
scope_title: From a timber door to a complete cabinet.
scope_intro: We make complete furniture, including doors, carcasses, shelves, drawers and hardware. Design, fabrication, finishing and installation where required can form one coordinated project.
scope_examples: Complete cabinets, reception counters, tables and side tables; facade panels, columns and reliefs; retail displays, museum and scenic elements. Material interfaces and installation responsibilities are defined at the outset.
scope_note: Turnkey completion covers the furniture and custom fabrication package defined in the quotation. Products, delivery and installation responsibilities are agreed in the quote and shop drawings.
workshop_title: Where the drawing becomes the object.
workshop_intro: At our workshop in Ferhatpaşa, Ataşehir, we bring CNC, composites, resin casting, 3D printing and woodworking together around the project.
about_title: A fabrication team behind your design.
about_intro: ARDIÇ Design & Fabrication is an Istanbul-based EPSLAM company. We bring family production experience together with architecture, interior design, digital fabrication and craft.
international_title: Made in Istanbul, delivered around your project.
international_intro: For projects in Europe, Russia and the Gulf, we assess dimensions, packing, transport and any installation scope during quotation. Lead time, shipping, customs and site responsibilities are agreed for the destination.
cta_title: Start with a drawing, photo or idea.
cta_intro: If you have not chosen a material, share the setting and approximate dimensions; we can work it out together.
compare_note: This is general guidance, not a fixed price or structural specification. Compare equivalent dimensions, quantity, finish and use.
contact_title: Share what you want to build.
contact_intro: An individual piece or a complete project. Start with a description, drawing or photo.
form_intro: Your name, email, country and a short description are enough to start. We can clarify the other details together.
message: What would you like us to build?
message_hint: For example, a complete cabinet, a timber door or facade elements. Add dimensions, quantity and installation needs if known.
files_help: PDF, JPG, PNG, WebP · Up to 3 files, 2 MB total. Share larger drawings and 3D models using a link.
nda_required: NDA required before detailed file exchange
nda_note: If an NDA is required, share a general outline first.
privacy_short: We use your details to review your enquiry and respond.
success_title: Your project has been sent to our team.
success_body: We will review your enquiry and respond using the contact details provided.
confirmation_sent: A confirmation was also sent to your email address.
confirmation_failed: A separate confirmation email could not be sent; your project enquiry reached our team.
thanks: Thank you for contacting ARDIÇ Design & Fabrication.
error_length: This text is too long. Please shorten it.
error_link: Enter an http or https share link without account credentials.
error_files: Choose up to 3 PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP files, 2 MB total. Check the files or use a share link.
error_verification: Verification could not be completed. Retry or contact us by email or WhatsApp.
error_unavailable: Online submission is currently unavailable. Please contact us by email or WhatsApp.
error_send: Your enquiry could not be sent. Try again later or contact us directly.
error_request: The request could not be processed. Reload the page and try again.
next_step_intro: Our team reviews your enquiry, clarifies the use, dimensions and scope with you, then prepares a quotation.
whatsapp_message: Hello ARDIÇ, I would like to discuss a design and fabrication project.
footer_note: An Istanbul-based EPSLAM company. Design, digital fabrication and workshop craft.
privacy_body: The name, email, country, language, project details and attachments entered in the form are sent to our team to assess and respond to your enquiry. Files are not placed in a public gallery; they accompany the team notification. Form details remain in page memory until submission.
privacy_services: The form uses Cloudflare Turnstile to reduce automated abuse and Resend for email delivery. The site is hosted on Vercel and includes usage measurement. Contact info@ardicdf.com about privacy or your information.
privacy_selection: Project selection stores only public example IDs in browser session storage. Language switching does not put your brief or personal information into the URL.
concepts_intro: Concepts are design directions for a new project. They are not completed project references or an off-the-shelf product list.
planning_intro: For an initial enquiry, share a drawing or photo, approximate dimensions, quantity, setting, finish, destination and installation needs. We can clarify missing information before quotation.
applications_intro: These are possible applications of our manufacturing methods. Scope and suitability are assessed for your project.
